in_sanskrit.name: Krishav
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Dark, God, Wealthy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Krishav एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Krishav is derived from the Sanskrit name Krishna, which means 'dark' or 'black' and is also an epithet of the Hindu god Vishnu. The name Krishna is also associated with the god Krishna, who is revered in Hinduism for his divine love, wisdom, and mischievous antics.
